properties.displayName: UAV S103 - Relative Position Spoofing (Collision Induction)
properties.description: UAVSwarmComms_CL의 relative_position 메시지에서 RelativePositionReported가 RelativePositionExpectedRange(동적 배열 [min,max], meter)를 벗어난 상대위치 스푸핑·충돌유도 탐지. 기대 최소값 미만(과도한 근접)은 충돌 위험이 높아 High, 기대 최대값 초과(과도한 이격)는 Medium으로 세분화. MITRE: T0806 Brute Force I/O (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
UAVSwarmComms_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MessageType == "relative_position"
| where isnotnull(RelativePositionReported) and isnotempty(RelativePositionExpectedRange)
| extend ExpMin = todouble(RelativePositionExpectedRange[0]), ExpMax = todouble(RelativePositionExpectedRange[1])
| where RelativePositionReported < ExpMin or RelativePositionReported > ExpMax
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("상대위치스푸핑_충돌유도_보고값:", tostring(RelativePositionReported), "m_기대범위:", tostring(ExpMin), "-", tostring(ExpMax), "m")
| extend Severity = iff(RelativePositionReported < ExpMin, "High", "Medium")
| project TimeGenerated, SwarmId, MemberId, UAVId, MessageType, RelativePositionReported, ExpMin, ExpMax, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S103 - Relative Position Spoofing (Collision Induction) - {{UAVId}}
